name: Auyuittuq National Park
policyReason: The park guidelines allow pets and sled dogs under control; no area bans are listed.
summary: Pets and sled dogs are allowed under physical control.

excerpts.quote: Pets and sled dogs must be kept under physical control at all times.

dogRules.text: Pets and sled dogs must be under physical control at all times.
Wildlife, weather and terrain can be dangerous for pets; never leave them unattended.
